Visible example: 3;1,2,3,4 returns 6,9.

reference.code:
const f=s=>{const p=s.split(';'),u=/^(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*)$/;if(p.length!==2||!/^[1-9][0-9]*$/.test(p[0])||Number(p[0])>100000||!p[1])return null;const w=Number(p[0]),a=[];for(const x of p[1].split(',')){if(!u.test(x)||Number(x)>10000000)return null;a.push(Number(x))}if(a.length<w)return null;let v=a.slice(0,w).reduce((x,y)=>x+y,0),o=[];if(v>10000000)return null;o.push(v);for(let j=w;j<a.length;j++){v+=a[j]-a[j-w];if(v>10000000)return null;o.push(v)}return o.join(',')};
exports.movingSums=f;
